title: The Parts of a Tree
content:
A tree has many important parts.

The roots are under the ground. They hold the tree in the soil and take in water and nutrients.

The trunk is the strong central part of the tree. It supports the branches and carries water to the rest of the tree.

The branches grow from the trunk. They hold the leaves, flowers, and fruit.

The leaves use sunlight to help the tree make food.

Some trees also have flowers and fruit. The fruit can contain seeds, which can grow into new trees.

Every part of a tree has an important job. Together, they help the tree grow and live.
